name: Charlotte
title: Heart of Monastir
description: The Grand Master of the Knights of the Duchy of Monastir. Though she strives to be a solemn and dignified leader, her naturally cheerful and simple personality always gets in the way.
introduction:
The Grand Master of the Monastir Knights from the Duchy of Monastir.
A commoner from the countryside, she became Grand Master through the recommendation of their former leader.
She struggles to act with the dignity expected of someone in her post before nobles or in official settings, as etiquette and formality do not come naturally to her, and it weighs heavily on her mind.
Resilient in both body and spirit, she recovers quickly as long as she sleeps and eats well.
